description: Offline evidence-status snapshot for Rev A5 LED gate, camera trigger, current-limit, rail-limit, output-state, and approval facts. This file is documentation/data only and is not a hardware test procedure.

live_action_gates.title: Trigger and LED no-guess gate
prohibited_actions: guessing controller pins, rails, LED part numbers, current limits, output types, or output states
connecting actual white, red, or green LEDs
using controller-board rails for LED power
skipping dummy-load or high-impedance LED-driver tests
skipping first low-current LED test prerequisites
evidence_fields_required: camera trigger voltage requirement, polarity, pulse-width requirement, output type, protection or level shifting, boot/reset state, dummy-signal plan, and oscilloscope test point

white, red, and green LED installed part or measured safe-current evidence, forward voltage, thermal path, current limit, driver output connector mapping, output type, polarity, boot/reset state, and fault/default behavior
LED supply voltage, available current budget, source identity, overcurrent protection, measurement method, and reviewer/source reference
dummy-load or high-impedance measurement plan, dummy load value or instrument impedance, current-sense test point, current-limit calculation, and pass/fail threshold
first low-current LED test approval with current setpoint, pulse width or duty cycle, duration, temperature observation plan, stop criteria, and reviewer approval
